panels.title: Observed apartment-sale exits · 30 days
panels.description: Closure cycles observed in the fixed apartment + sale scope. An exit is disappearance from observation, not a confirmed transaction.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS observed_exits FROM dashboard_public.exit_cycles WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'

panels.title: Median observed duration · days
panels.description: Time from first observation of the closure cycle to disappearance. Observation may begin after OLX publication; active listings are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS exit_sample, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_listed))::int AS median_observed_days FROM dashboard_public.exit_cycles WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND days_listed IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Reopened cycles · 30 days
panels.description: A reopened article creates a new cycle; a preceding closure remains in historical exit counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS reopened_cycles FROM dashboard_public.exit_cycles WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND reopened_cycle

panels.title: Recently observed apartment-sale exits
panels.description: Last asking price is resolved at closure time and is not a sale price. NULL means the evidence boundary was not a valid priced state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title, url, closed_at, days_listed, last_asking_price, last_asking_ppm2, rooms, sqm, reopened_cycle
FROM dashboard_public.exit_cycles
WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY closed_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Observed exits by duration
panels.description: Duration buckets describe time observed by this tracker and should not be read as seller or transaction behavior.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN days_listed <= 7 THEN '0–7 days' WHEN days_listed <= 14 THEN '8–14 days' WHEN days_listed <= 30 THEN '15–30 days' WHEN days_listed <= 60 THEN '31–60 days' ELSE '60+ days' END AS duration_bucket, count(*)::int AS observed_exits
FROM dashboard_public.exit_cycles
WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND days_listed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(days_listed)

panels.title: Exit freshness and scope
panels.description: The exit view is historical and depends on completed analytics; current freshness is shown for the tracked apartment search category.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, configured_searches, last_success_at, CASE WHEN last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN last_success_at < now() - INTERVAL '26 hours' THEN 'Stale' ELSE 'Current' END AS freshness
FROM dashboard_public.freshness WHERE category = 'apartments'
